demos.label: Mutkapolku ja suora polku oikaistaan rinnakkain

demos.say: Leveys ei ole pituutta. Leveä punainen on lyhyempi kuin ohut sininen.
demos.label: static

assumptions: M-MEAS-00 direct comparison from a common start.
Nonstretching material; bending and translation alone add/remove nothing.
Cut is zero-kerf idealisation; both retained halves count when comparing combined length.
No centimetre/ruler reading, addition/multiplication or formal geometry prerequisite.
planning.scope: Same240-unit ribbon, wide160 vs narrow240, two routes240 vs240cos(.75), two120 pieces, retained180 after removing60. Internal units not child arithmetic.
planning.interaction: Manually controlled nonstretching chain, route straightening, exact piece translation; qualitative comparisons.
planning.concreteToRepresentation: Physical comparison and teacher procedure → original diagram → controllable same-quantity model → short practice/feedback → transfer/offline discussion.
planning.evidenceLimit: Local supported low-stakes comparison only; no real-object competence, learner data, formal mastery, retention or efficacy claim.
